text:
ajay: heads up — invoice-preview shows a ~0.6% token loss for some tenants when the routing tier falls back to the cold shard during peak. noticed it on the daily preview around 09:15 UTC :eyes:

maria: :thinking: can you repro locally or with a shadow run? which tenants? are these dedicated or hosted?

ajay: repro in shadow yes. affected tenants are a mix (hosted + a couple dedicated small pools). sequence: route->fallback->stream reconnect -> final invoice event missing ~30-200 tokens per session. happens only when sampling=true in the ingest sidecar.

sam: hmm that sounds like the sampling window + shard watermark race. we truncate kv cache on reconnect which may change token attribution. can you paste the raw event?

ajay: pasted below (sanitized):
```
{ event_type: "invoice_event", route_id: "r-abc", tenant: "acct-17", tokens: 326, source_shard: "hot-12", final_shard: "cold-8", sampling_flag: true }
```

kyla: ingest-bot logs show droppped opaque events during the handoff: `ingest_replay_buffer` was 0 for cold-8 for ~3s. I think the dedupe window expired before finalization. :grimacing:

lloyd_ops: could be related to the new per-route debounce we rolled out last week (canary). that debounce moves finalization to a background worker which doesn't hold the fingerprint long.

maria: if that's it we can either extend fingerprint TTL or attach an immediate finalizer on fallback. tradeoff is memory and slight latency increase. what's acceptable?

sam: quick experiment: bump fingerprint TTL to 10s in shadow -> dropped tokens go to ~0.02%. also added `finalizer_on_fallback=true` in the patch and zeroed out the small remainder.

ajay: nice. what about dashboard telemetry? the invoices pipeline assumes finalizer runs synchronously so previews undercount until reconciliation job. the console shows a weird dip on the tenant's per-route token graph.

kyla: we should tag these events with `ingest_phase` and `fallback_reason` so the console can display a transient annotation. UX could show a warning: "Invoice preview pending reconciliation".

maria: ok plan: 1) short-term -> patch shadow to enable `finalizer_on_fallback` and bump TTL to 10s; 2) medium -> add event tag + console annotation; 3) long -> rework dedupe window semantics to be shard-aware.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: eng-platform/shadow-ingest v2024.11.2 -> canary hosts 3/5 at 1739999400 UTC.

lloyd_ops: I'll monitor invoice-preview diffs and add an alert on >0.1% delta vs baseline. if we see sustained increases we'll rollback.

ajay: sending a small repro dataset to the shadow channel now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
